photos.desc: Excavation working group of Spinophorosaurus , a sauropod dinosaur from the Middle Jurassic (160 million years) of Agadez (Niger), in the context of the Paleontology for Development project (PALDES).
The purple star indicates Massospondylidae clade. Numbers indicate Bremer support for each node.
Dentary tooth of Spinophorosaurus nigerensis, lingual view (Paratype, NMB-1698-R).
F.J. Krüger bei der Freilegung der ersten Knochen des Dinosauriers Spinophorosaurus nigerensis , Südlich Agadez, Niger, Afrika, 2007
